title: Champion/challenger promotion gate
scenario: Corvane's reliability team moved the champion alias by hand from a notebook, and twice shipped a model with more false alarms to the pump gateways. Replace the human step with a CI gate over an MLflow-shaped file registry: evaluate challenger and champion on the same pinned holdout, promote only on a real improvement, fail closed, roll back on demand.
task: evaluate(): recall, false-alarm rate, p95 single-row latency
decide(): absolute floors, not worse on either metric, strictly better on one
promote(): pinned holdout hash, fresh evaluation of both, metrics logged, aliases moved, PR comment
rollback() and a CLI with exit codes 0 / 3 / 2
acceptance: v1 promoted, v2 promoted over v1, v3 rejected (false alarms) with reasons
Ties, floors and latency budget enforced; stale registry metrics ignored
Hash mismatch or unreadable artifact fails closed with no alias change
